2610.04907.title: Why Subliminal Learning Needs So Much Data: A Noisy Inverse View through Steering Vector Recovery
2610.04907.paper_summary: Subliminal learning lets a student inherit a teacher's behavioral trait from semantically unrelated data, yet published demonstrations typically require tens of thousands of carrier examples. We ask where this data requirement comes from. Our testbed is subliminal steering: the teacher trait is a known residual-stream vector $Δ_T$, so transfer can be measured directly as parameter recovery. On identical carrier prefixes, we compare token-level (hard) NLL supervision with full-distribution (soft) KL supervision. At initialization the two objectives give nearly collinear gradients, and both align poorly with $Δ_T$. Under iterative optimization, however, they diverge: soft supervision recovers $Δ_T$ almost exactly from a few hundred carriers, while hard supervision stays well below it even with tens of thousands. We explain this gap by casting steering-vector distillation as a noisy linear inverse problem. Locally, the carrier task maps the trait through its Fisher matrix $F$, so gradients point toward $FΔ_T$ rather than $Δ_T$. Gradient descent then acts as a progressively less-damped inverse of $F$. With soft targets, this inverse restores low-curvature directions. With hard labels, it also amplifies the sampling noise in those same directions. The result is an optimal inversion depth that grows with the number of independent carriers. Experiments on Qwen2.5-7B and Gemma-2-9B confirm four predictions: the Fisher distortion of the initial gradient, recovery ordered from steep to flat directions, an optimal depth that shifts with data scale, and the finding that resampling completions from a fixed prompt pool works as well as adding new prompts. In this setting, large carrier datasets are needed less to reveal the trait than to suppress label noise amplified by Fisher inversion. Code is available at \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data}.
2610.04907.paper_summary_zh: 潛意識學習讓學生從語義上無關的數據中繼承教師的行為特徵，但已發表的實驗通常需要數萬個載體範例。我們詢問這種數據需求的來源。我們的測試平台是潛意識引導：教師特徵是一個已知的殘餘流向量 $Δ_T$，因此可以直接測量轉移作為參數恢復。在相同的載體前綴上，我們比較了標記級別（硬）NLL 監督與全分佈（軟）KL 監督。在初始化時，這兩個目標給出了幾乎共線的梯度，並且兩者都與 $Δ_T$ 的對齊度較差。然而，在迭代優化下，它們卻發生了分歧：軟監督幾乎完全從幾百個載體中恢復 $Δ_T$，而硬監督即使在數萬個載體下也遠低於它。我們通過將引導向量蒸餾視為一個噪聲線性逆問題來解釋這一差距。在局部，載體任務通過其費舍爾矩陣 $F$ 將特徵映射，因此梯度指向 $FΔ_T$ 而不是 $Δ_T$。然後，梯度下降作為 $F$ 的逐漸減少的逆向作用。對於軟目標，這個逆向恢復了低曲率方向。對於硬標籤，它也在這些相同方向上放大了取樣噪聲。結果是最佳的反演深度隨著獨立載體的數量而增長。在 Qwen2.5-7B 和 Gemma-2-9B 上的實驗確認了四個預測：初始梯度的費舍爾扭曲、從陡峭到平坦方向的恢復排序、隨著數據規模變化的最佳深度，以及從固定提示池重新取樣完成的效果與添加新提示一樣好。在這種情況下，所需的大型載體數據集不僅是為了揭示特徵，更是為了抑制費舍爾反演放大的標籤噪聲。代碼可在 \url{https://github.com/luoyuchenmlcv/subliminal-data} 獲得。
